title: Interpretation 00-09 (City of Bothell): 'substantially equivalent or greater accessibility' under the UBC alternate-methods section 1101.4 (ADAAG comparisons)
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by City of Bothell (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 1997 UBC, State Regulations for Barrier-Free Facilities, Sections 1101.4, 1106.11.6, 1106.11.7.3.1, 1106.16.3, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 00-09, two pages; requester City of Bothell; five questions.

Question 1: how 'substantially equivalent or greater accessibility' under the alternate-methods provision (Section 1101.4) is determined where numerical or physical differences result from the state rules and ADAAG.
Question 2: whether ADAAG Section 4.19.2 lavatory clearances compliance provides equivalent accessibility to Section 1106.11.7.3.1.
Question 3: whether black stencil international symbol signs on brushed aluminum (ADAAG 4.30.5) are equivalent to the white-on-blue requirement of Section 1106.16.3.
Question 4: whether urinal screens may extend beyond the front edge of the urinal rim where the clear space between screens is 30 inches or more (ADAAG 4.18.3).
Question 5: whether sinks in kitchenettes or lounges are subject to Section 1106.
